name: Linn County, MO
findings: Linn County has 51 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Linn County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
